title: Synthetic service-continuity CSV row v1.0.0
description: Schema applies to typed CSV values: booleans true/false, decimal numbers; every record is synthetic. Units and Spanish descriptions are annotations. See dataset cards for conservation equations and limits.

synthetic.description: Every row is synthetic, not an observation.
synthetic.description_es: Toda fila es sintética, no una observación.

seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit scenario seed; shared across policies.
seed.description_es: Semilla de escenario de 32 bits sin signo; común a las políticas.

hour.description: Relative interval start, not a calendar timestamp.
hour.description_es: Inicio relativo del intervalo, no una fecha de calendario.

capacity_slots.description: Installed slots, each delivering one service unit per hour.
capacity_slots.description_es: Plazas instaladas; cada una entrega una unidad de servicio por hora.

recovery_budget_slots_per_hour.description: Maximum slots repairable per hour, separate from service throughput.
recovery_budget_slots_per_hour.description_es: Máximo de plazas reparables por hora, separado del servicio.

demand_service_units.description: Demand arriving within this one-hour interval.
demand_service_units.description_es: Demanda que llega en este intervalo de una hora.

requested_unavailable_slots.description: Exogenous requested loss; identical input across policies for a seed.
requested_unavailable_slots.description_es: Pérdida exógena solicitada; entrada idéntica entre políticas para una semilla.

newly_unavailable_slots.description: Realized loss, capped at slots still available at interval start.
newly_unavailable_slots.description_es: Pérdida efectiva, limitada a plazas disponibles al inicio.

unavailable_start_slots.description: Unavailable slots inherited from previous end of hour; initially zero.
unavailable_start_slots.description_es: Plazas no disponibles heredadas del final anterior; inicialmente cero.

unavailable_during_slots.description: Unavailable during service, after interruption and before repair.
unavailable_during_slots.description_es: Plazas no disponibles durante el servicio, tras la interrupción y antes de reparar.

available_during_slots.description: Slots able to serve demand in this interval.
available_during_slots.description_es: Plazas capaces de atender demanda en este intervalo.

served_service_units.description: Work served, bounded by demand and available slots times one hour.
served_service_units.description_es: Servicio entregado, limitado por demanda y plazas disponibles por una hora.

unmet_service_units.description: Unserved work discarded at interval end; no backlog.
unmet_service_units.description_es: Servicio no atendido descartado al terminar el intervalo; sin cola.

recovered_slots.description: End-of-hour repairs; cannot serve work until the next interval.
recovered_slots.description_es: Reparaciones al final de la hora; no sirven demanda hasta el intervalo siguiente.

unavailable_end_slots.description: Unavailable slots carried to next interval, after repair.
unavailable_end_slots.description_es: Plazas no disponibles trasladadas al intervalo siguiente, después de reparar.

service_ratio.description: Served/demand; defined as one when demand is zero.
service_ratio.description_es: Servicio/demanda; se define como uno si la demanda es cero.

capacity_availability_ratio.description: Available/installed capacity during service; not service fulfilment.
capacity_availability_ratio.description_es: Capacidad disponible/instalada durante el servicio; no es demanda satisfecha.

recovered_to_full.description: True only when positive unavailable capacity reaches zero at this interval end.
recovered_to_full.description_es: Verdadero solo cuando una pérdida positiva de capacidad llega a cero al final del intervalo.
